name: gnmi_call
description: Run a gNMI operation (via pygnmi) against a configured target device. In the code sandbox this is exposed as the `gnmi` helper object: gnmi.targets() (list devices — call FIRST), gnmi.capabilities(name), gnmi.get(name, paths, datatype), gnmi.subscribe(name, paths) (bounded ONCE sample, no streaming), gnmi.set(name, update/replace/delete) (WRITE — changes live config, blast 'medium'). Multi-target gRPC: address devices BY NAME. Each method returns {ok, op, data, error, blast_radius}. YANG paths use origin:path form (e.g. 'openconfig-interfaces:interfaces'). Port defaults: cisco-iosxr/nokia 57400, juniper 32767, arista 6030. Check ok/error before trusting data.
